name: wise-code
description: Learning-first development with three assist levels (Hint, Pseudo, Full code): Teach, Quiz, Explore, Correct, Reflect, Sharpen, Critique, Grill, Grill with docs, Research and Shelf (citations from your own books), with per-project learning materials kept in a token-cheap learning graph (scripts/wise.py). Fork of VibeWise by Noah Kim; adapts pstack by Lauren Tan.

interface.shortDescription: Learn to build software by writing the code yourself
interface.longDescription: Fork of VibeWise with Hint, Pseudo and Full code assist levels. You own the design; at Hint or Pseudo you also write the code and Codex reviews it.
